text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The new civil service performance apparaisal system introduced by the Zimbabwe government in 1996 to standardise the approaches used in different ministries will be implemented this year, a Public Service Commisssion official said on Tuesday night.
- Zimbabwe's health and child welfare ministry on Tuesday assured the nation that the pneumonic and bubonic plagues that have broken out in parts of neighbouring Zambia pose no threat to Zimbabwe.
